explanation: The two articles number themselves in one series. Sadras “was the first of five largely indecisive naval battles fought between a British fleet (under Vice-Admiral Sir Edward Hughes) and a French fleet (under Admiral Pierre Suffren) off the east coast of India during the Anglo-French War”; Providien “was the second in a series of naval battles fought between” the same two fleets and the same two admirals. An ordered series named as one by both of its members is a claim about the campaign, not a date order: `precondition-of`, and `probable` because Wikipedia states the sequence and no mechanism between these two.
